features: NEW GOLF CHIPPING GAME SET-【WARNING: CHOKING HAZARD-SMALL PARTS NOT FOR CHILDREN UNDER 3 YEARS】The chipping golf mat set is a great indoor and outdoor golf game for the whole family, is suitable for beginners and adults of all skill levels.This set includes a large Double Sided Golf Game Mat (69" L X 69" W ),20 Sticky Golf Balls, 4 Ground Stakes, 4 Sticking Hook, 1 Scoreboard with pen, 1 Hitting Mat, 1 Storage Bag, 4 Ribbon. Suitable for beginners and skilled players to practice golf.

BATTLE ROYALE GOLF GAME&TOSS GAME-Our Double Sided Golf Mat consists of a real putting green scene and a darts practice mat. The double sided sticky golf chipping game mat can be used as a golf game scene, an indoor or outdoor game, a chipping training aid, battle royale golf game, a golf starter toy, or a wall-hanging tossing game, which greatly increases the fun of playing.

HIGH QUALITY & GOLF GAME MAT THICKENED-Our golf hitting mat is thickened.The golf hitting mat is a fine woven structure and washable material that is durable,and the golf hitting mat with thickening treatment is not easy to offset and deformation.The sticky balls are solid enough to shoot but soft enough not to cause damage to walls or indoor fixtures.

FAMILY & PARTY GAME FUN: Go for the Win! Each player takes a turn chipping their ball to the mat trying to hit the marked scoring area to get the most points. The mat is brightly colored with a center goal and obstacles. Shoot for the center for the most points. Just beware of the sand traps and water,etc. Those are all points lost.

OUTDOOR INDOOR PLAYING FUN - The golf mat can be used flat on the indoor floor without deflecting or deforming easily, or you can hold it in place with ground stakes outdoors. We also have 4 stcky hooks and a score card so you can hang the golf mat on the wall to practice scoring. Use the included storage bag to conveniently take your entire golf game set out to play and use it.
